title: Is this word an op?
hints: The words in the tests are cut out of longer text, so each one is a new string. Can a new string be the same object as one in `ops`?
`==` asks whether two values are the same object in memory. You want to know whether they hold the same letters.

answer.explain: The reference compares with `=`: `List.exists (fun op -> op = name) ops`. A word cut from a line of text is a fresh string, so it is never the same object as a string in `ops`, and `==` says false even when every letter matches.
